'''Keoulkeech''' was a legendary warrior and hunter from [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] mythology who found ways of fighting the [[Gorax/Legends|Gorax]]. "Keoulkeech" was a popular name given to male Ewoks,<ref name="GCG" /> such as [[Keoulkeech|the shaman]] from [[Red Bush Grove]].<ref name="H&R">''[[Heroes & Rogues]]''</ref>
